		if state.hl then
			return
		end

		Appearance._hideHead(environment, character, state)
		return
	end

	if not state.hl then
		return
	end

	for _, saved in environment.ipairs(state.hl) do
		if saved[1].Parent then
			environment.pcall(function()
				saved[1].Transparency = saved[2]
			end)
		end
	end

	state.hl = nil
end

function Appearance._hideHead(environment, character, state)
	local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head")

	if not head then
		return
	end

	state.hl = {{head, head.Transparency}}
	Appearance._makeInvisible(environment, head)

	for _, descendant in environment.ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
		if descendant:IsA("Decal") and descendant.Name == "face" then
			state.hl[#state.hl + 1] = {descendant, descendant.Transparency}
			Appearance._makeInvisible(environment, descendant)
		end
	end
end

function Appearance._makeInvisible(environment, object)
	environment.pcall(function()
		object.Transparency = 1
	end)
end

function Appearance.applyChams(context, character, state, settings)
	if not settings then
		context.restore(state)
		return
	end

	local environment = context.environment
	local red = environment.math.floor(settings.c / 65536) % 256
	local green = environment.math.floor(settings.c / 256) % 256
	local blue = (settings.c or 0) % 256
	local color = environment.Color3.fromRGB(red, green, blue)

	state.ch = state.ch or {}
	state.chSeen = state.chSeen or {}

	local material = Appearance._chamsMaterial(environment, settings)

	for _, part in environment.ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
		Appearance._paintPart(context, {part = part, state = state, settings = settings, material = material, color = color})
	end
end

function Appearance._chamsMaterial(environment, settings)
	local material = environment.Enum.Material.ForceField

	if not settings.y then
		return material
	end

	local resolve = environment.getgenv().__pulseChamsMat
	local ok, resolved = environment.pcall(function()
		if resolve then
			return resolve(settings.y)
		end

		return resolve
	end)

	if ok and environment.typeof(resolved) == "EnumItem" then
		material = resolved
	end

	return material
end

function Appearance._paintPart(context, selection)
	local part = selection.part
	local settings = selection.settings
	local state = selection.state

	if not part:IsA("BasePart") or not (part.Transparency < 1) then
		return
	end

	local isClassified = context.classifyPart(part)

	if not ((isClassified and settings.t) or (not isClassified and settings.s)) then
		return
	end

	if not state.chSeen[part] then
		state.chSeen[part] = context.seenValue()
		state.ch[#state.ch + 1] = {part, part.Material, part.Color}
	end

	if part.Material == selection.material and part.Color == selection.color then
		return
	end

	context.environment.pcall(function()
		part.Material = selection.material
		part.Color = selection.color
	end)
end
